title: LocalAI/persona.json
description: The name, picture, greeting and instructions of the assistant in every chat of this user.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.description: The picture of the assistant: the path of a picture in your files, without a leading slash, such as Pictures/avatars/juniper.png. A png, jpg, jpeg, webp, gif or avif file. No .. and no address.

greeting.title: Greeting
greeting.description: The first line of the assistant in a new chat. It is shown, not sent to the model. Placeholders: {user.name}, {time_of_day}, {date}.

emptyChat.title: Empty chat
emptyChat.description: What a new, empty chat shows above the message box.

subtitle.description: One line under the headline. Placeholders: {user.name}, {time_of_day}, {date}.

showShortcuts.description: Show your shortcuts above the message box of an empty chat. Default true.

system_prompt.title: System prompt
system_prompt.description: Added to every chat, after the chat's own system prompt and the agent's instructions.
